calm.rule: -3 dB vs default; skip CAP ticks except keywords; whooshes low-passed 6 kHz

energetic.rule: default levels; allow layered swish+thump; up to 2 SFX/s

faceless.rule: default; every object entrance gets its sound; pops pitched to music key if possible

signature.rule: -2 dB; prefer air/shimmer over clicks; impacts only on title slams
